class.name: RealityKitDirectionalLightShadow3D
class.brief_description: Opts a DirectionalLight3D into fixed orthographic shadow projection on visionOS.
class.description: Add a [b]RealityKitDirectionalLightShadow3D[/b] as a child of a [DirectionalLight3D] to use a fixed orthographic shadow projection instead of the default automatic shadow projection (which fits the shadow map to the camera frustum). The orthographic projection is defined by [member z_near], [member z_far], and [member orthographic_scale], and is oriented along the light's direction.

members.member: Bias applied to shadow depth to reduce shadow acne. Matches RealityKit's default of [code]1.0[/code].
Width and height (in meters) of the orthographic shadow projection box.
Far clipping distance of the shadow projection, in meters.
Near clipping distance of the shadow projection, in meters.
